description.CAS: Arregla la cuenta atrás de 5 a 1.

initialCode.ENG:
print('Are you ready?')
number = 5
while number > 0:
    print(number)
    number = number - 1
print('Now!')

import unittest
class TestCountdown(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_run(self):
        out = run_student_code()
        self.assertIn('5', out)
        self.assertIn('1', out)
        self.assertIn('Now!', out)

import unittest
class TestPowers(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_10(self):
        out = run_student_code(inputs=['10'])
        self.assertIn('1', out)
        self.assertIn('8', out)
        self.assertNotIn('16', out)

import unittest
class TestBaseN(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_limit_100_base_3(self):
        out = run_student_code(inputs=['100', '3'])
        self.assertIn('1', out)
